context: Two news editors plan a special science segment
purpose: Teach: 公明党/火星/追悼/後退/帰還/露出/断言/賭け

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来月の特集ですが、火星探査機の無事帰還に合わせた科学コーナーを組みたいんです。
lines.en: For next month's special, I want to build a science segment around the Mars probe's safe return.
lines.style: Eager junior editor pitching with measured professional enthusiasm here.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいタイミングね。ちょうど追悼特集が重なる週だから、視聴者の露出を増やすには絶好の枠よ。
lines.en: Good timing. It overlaps with the memorial special week, so it's a perfect slot to boost viewer exposure.
lines.style: Senior editor responding crisply with strategic broadcast scheduling instincts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ただ、政治班から公明党の党首会見も同じ日に入りそうで、尺の取り合いになるかもしれません。
lines.en: But the politics desk says the Komeito leader's press conference might land the same day, so we'll fight over airtime.
lines.style: Cautious tone flagging an internal scheduling conflict respectfully here.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そこは一歩も後退しないで。科学班が押し負けたら、来期の予算まで影響するって断言できる。
lines.en: Don't give an inch there. If the science desk loses out, I can flat-out say it'll hit next quarter's budget too.
lines.style: Firm pushback delivered with seasoned newsroom political awareness here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。じゃあ帰還カプセルの映像と、研究者インタビューを軸に十五分構成で組みます。
lines.en: Understood. Then I'll build a fifteen-minute segment around the return capsule footage and researcher interviews.
lines.style: Practical follow-up showing concrete editorial planning steps clearly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 研究者は誰を呼ぶつもり?著名な人じゃないと、深夜枠に飛ばされる賭けになるわよ。
lines.en: Who are you planning to invite? Unless they're a big name, you're betting on getting bumped to a late-night slot.
lines.style: Probing question with veteran skepticism about guest booking strategy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 東大の佐藤教授に打診中です。彼が出てくれれば、視聴率は文字通り跳ねます。
lines.en: I'm sounding out Professor Sato from Todai. If he agrees, the ratings will literally jump.
lines.style: Confident but still hedged answer showing booking-in-progress reality clearly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: じゃあ今週中に確定させて。月曜の編成会議までに台本初稿、お願いね。
lines.en: Then lock it in by end of week. First draft of the script before Monday's programming meeting, please.
lines.style: Closing the meeting with crisp directive senior-editor delivery here.
